description: Jahangir Siddiqui & Co. Ltd. was incorporated in Pakistan in 1991 as successor to the equity, fixed income and corporate finance business established by Mr. Jahangir Siddiqui, and was the first securities company in Pakistan with a Wall Street pedigree through its former joint venture partner Bear Stearns. It is primarily an investment company in financial services, with holdings across commercial and Islamic banking, asset management, investment banking, securities brokerage and insurance, alongside long-term investments in technology, transport, media and industrial companies. Its other activities are trading of securities, consultancy services and underwriting.
